name: io.github.MeorinGroup/public-records-ma
title: Meorin public records MA
description: Cited Massachusetts property facts from public records, paid per call over x402 (USDC).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Free. The Massachusetts public-record answers this server sells, with their prices in USD (paid in USDC over x402) and their sources.

tools.name: parcel
tools.description: The Massachusetts tax parcel for a street address: its Meorin parcel id, the MassGIS LOC_ID and map-parcel id, the town, the address as the state records it, and a point inside the lot. From the state's 911 address list and the MassGIS statewide parcel layer (public records). No owner names. Not charged when no parcel is found. Costs $0.01 (USDC over x402).

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: parcel_facts
tools.description: The assessor's facts for a Massachusetts parcel as the MassGIS statewide parcel layer carries them: use code and description, zoning district, lot size, year built, living and building area, units, style, the assessed value with its fiscal year, and the last sale over $1,000 (date and price). Public records, each answer citing the layer. No owner names. Give an address or a LOC_ID. Costs $0.02 (USDC over x402).

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: flood_zone
tools.description: The FEMA flood zone at a Massachusetts parcel (AE, A, VE, X, X 0.2% a year), whether it is a special flood hazard area (mandatory flood insurance with a federally backed mortgage), the static base flood elevation where FEMA gives one, and every zone touching the lot. From FEMA's National Flood Hazard Layer (the state's copy, then FEMA's own). US government data. Costs $0.02 (USDC over x402).

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: sewer
tools.description: Whether a Massachusetts parcel is inside a mapped municipal sewer service area (MassDEP), with the sewer system and treatment plant, or outside every one and so most likely on a septic system (Title 5 applies at sale). The connection itself is not recorded. Public record. Costs $0.01 (USDC over x402).

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: census_tract
tools.description: The census geography at a Massachusetts parcel from the US Census Bureau's geocoder: tract and block group GEOIDs, county and county FIPS, and the town (county subdivision). The keys to join ACS, HUD, FEMA NRI and other tract-level data. US government data. Costs $0.01 (USDC over x402).

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: property_profile
tools.description: A Massachusetts property profile in one call, for an address or a LOC_ID: the parcel, the assessor's facts, the FEMA flood zone, sewer or septic, and the census tract, each part citing its public source. No owner names, no listing data. Costs $0.05 (USDC over x402).

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: dossier
tools.description: A Massachusetts house's dossier as cited public-record facts in JSON: the parcel, the building, assessments and tax by year, zoning and what the by-law allows on the lot, flood and environment, schools, permits on record, the county's price trend and the value the assessment implies, and the ten-year forecast's big replacements; each fact with its value, source and citation. No listing or MLS data, no licensed data, no title or registry facts, no names of people, no prose. A house Meorin has built answers at once; a new address starts a build (202 with a job to poll, free) and is charged only when the build succeeds. Over MCP, houses Meorin has built only. Costs $1.00 (USDC over x402).

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town
